title: Special Blue Ultra Pure Butane Plus 420ML (CAN NOT BE EXPRESSS SHIPPED)
description:
Special Blue Butane 420ML
Ideal for filling your jet lighters but is also sorted for extraction. Special Blue ultra pure butane plus is a premium European gas that is proving to be dependable.
When it comes to filling lighters the metal filling nozzle will generally do the job in most cases. But in cases where it is not the right size it comes with 5 plastic adapters. And for you extractors out there this can also comes with a little rubber cones shapes adapter which will fit most extractors.
Shipping Considerations, Can NOT be shipped express.
As butane is a flammable gas 2 it can only be shipped via road services. This in general means that express makes no difference to delivery times. So please don’t select express with this in your cart. We ship from the Brisbane area so if you live within a few hundred kilometres shipping times will be the same by road anyway. But if over the other side of the country just be aware this order will need to go via road and could take longer then usual.
Included
1 x Special Blue Ultra Pure Butane Plus 420ML
